purpose: Robustness-corpus extension: four machine-discovered events across four new topic dimensions. The 36-article frozen core and the NewJeans fact-check corpus are not modified.
selection_rules: One new event per topic across four of the six design topics.
Events carry no hand-selected articles; base and shell URLs are machine-discovered from news search.
Every article must fall inside the frozen six-month window.
Each event targets coverage with concrete numbers, dates, forecast modality, or attribution.
The extension never modifies the 36-article frozen core or the NewJeans fact-check corpus.

events.selection_reason: Tests numeric precision and attribution for a central-bank rate decision covered by wire services and local outlets in all three languages.
primary_facts: The Bank of Korea set its base rate at a February 2026 decision.
The statement cited inflation or growth conditions for the decision.
Commentary attributed different weight to the same figures.

events.selection_reason: Tests case-count numbers and date scope in outbreak reporting where totals update daily and differ between official figures and press summaries.
primary_facts: Health authorities reported a rising dengue case count in 2026.
Daily totals differed between official figures and press summaries.
Coverage emphasized regional hospitals and prevention campaigns.

events.selection_reason: Tests forecast modality and uncertainty wording across meteorology agencies and regional coverage.
primary_facts: Forecast agencies projected El Nino conditions for the 2026-27 season.
Probabilities differed across agencies and update dates.
Regional reporting tied the forecast to rainfall and crop impacts.

events.selection_reason: Tests attribution and uncertainty in entertainment coverage where a reunion report was covered with conflicting sourcing and later clarifications.
primary_facts: Media reported a BTS reunion plan with different attributions.
Agency statements and fan reporting sometimes conflicted.
Coverage mixed confirmed dates with speculation.
